origin.description: Finite-difference solution of y'' = f(x) y' + g(x) y + h(x), with the boundary values stored at the ends of the grid.
origin.usage: bvp(f, g, h, x, y, n = 50)

arguments.name: f
arguments.text: Coefficient of y', or a constant.

arguments.name: g
arguments.text: Coefficient of y, or a constant.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The two ends of the interval.

arguments.name: n
arguments.text: Number of interior grid points, an integer of at least 2.

origin.details: y'' = y on [0, 1], y(0) = 1, y(1) = exp(-1), with eight interior points.
origin.value: Finite-difference solution of y'' = f(x) y' + g(x) y + h(x), with the boundary values stored at the ends of the grid.
